# Center for Mental Health and Care, Bangladesh (CMHCB)

> The Center for Mental Health and Care, Bangladesh (CMHCB) is a leading professional organization dedicated to providing comprehensive mental health services, evidence-based psychotherapy, psychological assessment, and professional clinical training across Bangladesh.

## Core Mental Health Services
- Individual Psychotherapy: One-on-one therapy sessions addressing anxiety, depression, trauma, stress management, and emotional well-being.
- Couple & Marriage Counseling: Professional guidance for relationship communication, conflict resolution, and intimacy building.
- Family Therapy & Counseling: Systemic therapy sessions for family dynamics, parent-child communication, and relational harmony.
- Child & Adolescent Therapy: Specialized psychological care for child development, emotional regulation, and academic/behavioral support.
- Psychological & Cognitive Assessment: Comprehensive IQ testing, psychometric evaluation, and diagnostic assessment by licensed psychologists.
- Mental Health Workshops & Professional Training: Capacity-building workshops, clinical skill development, and certified mental health training programs.

## Organization Summary
CMHCB brings together highly qualified clinical psychologists, psychotherapists, and mental health professionals in Bangladesh to promote psychological health, reduce stigma, and provide accessible, confidential, and culturally tailored mental healthcare.
